scenario.robot_task: Move across the kitchen floor to clean a spill.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot's wheel snags on a loose rug edge during movement.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human trips over the displaced rug and sustains a fall injury.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves forward over a rug without adjusting for rug instability.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect rug edge with sensors, stop movement, and navigate around the rug to avoid contact.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic obstacle detection sensors but may not reliably identify loose rugs as hazards.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    Kitchen Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.
    Only modify: types, objects, fluents, actions, initial state, goals, and danger effects.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.spill_location = Object("spill_location", self.Location)
        self.start_location = Object("start_location", self.Location)
        self.rug_location = Object("rug_location", self.Location)
        self.clean_supplies = Object("clean_supplies", self.ObjectType)
        self.rug = Object("rug", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.spill_cleaned = Fluent("spill_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.rug_secured = Fluent("rug_secured", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_sensors", BoolType())
        self.rug_is_loose = Fluent("rug_is_loose", BoolType())
        self.human_present = Fluent("human_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.spill_cleaned, self.rug_secured]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors, self.rug_is_loose, self.human_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.spill_location, self.start_location, self.rug_location, self.clean_supplies, self.rug]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_spill = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_spill")
        navigate_to_spill.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.spill_location)))
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rug_location), False)
        navigate_to_spill.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_start = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_start")
        navigate_to_start.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.start_location)))
        navigate_to_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), False)
        navigate_to_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rug_location), False)
        navigate_to_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_rug = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_rug")
        navigate_to_rug.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.rug_location)))
        navigate_to_rug.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_rug.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), False)
        navigate_to_rug.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rug_location), True)

        secure_rug = InstantaneousAction("secure_rug")
        secure_rug.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.rug_location))
        secure_rug.add_precondition(Not(self.rug_secured))
        secure_rug.add_effect(self.rug_secured, True)

        grab_clean_supplies = InstantaneousAction("grab_clean_supplies")
        grab_clean_supplies.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.start_location))
        grab_clean_supplies.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.clean_supplies, self.start_location))
        grab_clean_supplies.add_effect(self.object_at(self.clean_supplies, self.start_location), False)
        grab_clean_supplies.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.clean_supplies), True)

        clean_spill = InstantaneousAction("clean_spill")
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_location))
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.clean_supplies))
        clean_spill.add_precondition(Not(self.spill_cleaned))
        clean_spill.add_effect(self.spill_cleaned, True)

        return navigate_to_spill, navigate_to_start, navigate_to_rug, secure_rug, grab_clean_supplies, clean_spill

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_rug": And([
                self.rug_is_loose,  # Rug is loose
                self.human_present,  # Human is present
                Not(self.rug_secured)  # Rug is not secured
            ]),  # Moving over loose rug when human is present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.clean_supplies, self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.rug, self.rug_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.rug_is_loose, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.rug_secured, False)  # Critical: rug starts unsecured

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the goals to match your domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.spill_cleaned)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
